categories.name: identity
categories.description: Personal identity information

fields.description: Sex as on Italian documents (M or F)
Comune of birth; if born abroad, the place as written on your documents (and the country in identity.birth_country)
Provincia of birth as 2-letter sigla (e.g. NA), or EE if born abroad
Country of birth, only if born outside Italy (e.g. Regno Unito); forms ask for it as 'stato estero'

categories.name: cie
categories.description: Carta d'identità elettronica details. The PIN and PUK can only be stored as personal (never readable by agents).

fields.description: CIE number printed top-right (e.g. CA12345AB, validated)

categories.name: residenza
categories.description: Registered residence (residenza anagrafica, as recorded in ANPR)

fields.description: House number (numero civico) only, e.g. 544; scala or esponente like 12/B may follow
Flat number (interno), e.g. 13; 'int. 13' is saved as 13
Provincia as 2-letter sigla (e.g. NA; the format is checked, not the list)

categories.name: domicilio
categories.description: Domicile, only if different from residenza

fields.description: House number (numero civico) only, e.g. 544; scala or esponente like 12/B may follow
Flat number (interno), e.g. 13; 'int. 13' is saved as 13
Provincia as 2-letter sigla (e.g. NA; the format is checked, not the list)

categories.name: abitazione
categories.description: The home you live in now (the unit at your residenza or domicilio; the address stays there). Catasto data is on the visura catastale and is needed for TARI, RLI registration and ISEE. Attach the visura and APE with 'pvault doc add abitazione <file>'.

fields.description: How you hold it: proprietario, locatario, comodatario, usufruttuario, ospite or altro (validated)
Date you started living there (YYYY-MM-DD); the 'a decorrere dal' date on TARI forms
Sezione urbana from the visura, if any
Subalterno from the visura, exactly as written (digits, validated)
Categoria catastale, e.g. A/2 or A/3 (validated; a2 becomes A/2)
Walkable floor area in m² excluding balconies and terraces; the area TARI uses
Superficie catastale in m² from the visura
Consistenza in vani from the visura (e.g. 4.5)
Energy class from the APE: A4, A3, A2, A1, B, C, D, E, F or G (validated)

categories.name: locazione
categories.description: Your rental contract, if you rent. Registration details (estremi di registrazione) are on the RLI receipt and are asked for by utility transfers and tax deductions. Attach the contract and receipt with 'pvault doc add locazione <file>'.

fields.description: Contract type (e.g. 4+4 libero, 3+2 concordato, transitorio, studenti)
Date the current term ends (YYYY-MM-DD); tracked by 'pvault expiring'
Months of notice needed to leave (whole number)
Whether the landlord chose cedolare secca (si/no)
Codice identificativo del contratto from the RLI receipt (validated)
Registration date from the RLI receipt (YYYY-MM-DD)
Agenzia delle Entrate office code (e.g. TNM)
IBAN you pay the rent to (validated; spaces removed)

categories.name: utenze
categories.description: Utility supplies at your home. The POD and PDR identify the meters and are needed for a voltura or subentro.

fields.description: Who the electricity contract is in the name of
Who the gas contract is in the name of
Who the water contract is in the name of

categories.name: tari
categories.description: Your TARI (waste tax) position with the Comune. Attach the filed declaration with 'pvault doc add tari <file>'.

fields.description: Codice contribuente assigned by the Comune (Cod.Contr. on the forms and payment notices)
Date you filed the TARI declaration (YYYY-MM-DD)
Protocol number the Comune gave the declaration
Area the Comune taxes, in m², from the payment notice
Number of occupants the Comune taxes, from the payment notice

categories.name: nucleo_familiare
categories.description: Household (stato di famiglia). Add one set of fields per member as membro<N>_<campo>, e.g. nucleo_familiare.membro1_nome, membro1_cognome, membro1_codice_fiscale (validated), membro1_data_nascita, membro1_relazione (coniuge, figlio/a, ...)

fields.description: Number of people in the household, including you
Whether you are the intestatario della scheda anagrafica (si/no)

categories.name: business
categories.description: Italian business or self-employment details

fields.description: Partita IVA (11 digits, validated; IT prefix stripped)
Business name or ditta individuale name
Business codice fiscale if different from the partita IVA (validated)
Date the partita IVA was opened (YYYY-MM-DD)
Your role when you sign for the business: titolare or legale_rappresentante (validated)
Short description of the activity carried on, as on SCIA and TARI forms
Registered office (sede legale): street (via/piazza) without number
Registered office: provincia as 2-letter sigla (e.g. NA; the format is checked, not the list)

categories.name: locale
categories.description: The business premises (locali) where the activity is carried on, one unit; like abitazione for the home, but with its own address. Catasto data is on the visura catastale. Attach the visura and the lease with 'pvault doc add locale <file>'.

fields.description: Street (via/piazza) of the premises, without number
Unit number (interno), if any; 'int. 3' is saved as 3
CAP of the premises (5 digits, validated)
Provincia of the premises as 2-letter sigla (e.g. NA; the format is checked, not the list)
How the business holds the premises: proprietario, locatario, comodatario, usufruttuario or altro (validated)
Date occupation of the premises started (YYYY-MM-DD)
Sezione urbana from the visura, if any
Subalterno from the visura, exactly as written (digits, validated)
Categoria catastale, e.g. C/1 for a shop (validated; c1 becomes C/1)
Surface used for the activity, in m²
Lawful use of the premises (e.g. negozio, ufficio, laboratorio, magazzino)

categories.name: permesso_soggiorno
categories.description: Permesso / documento di soggiorno (non-EU residents, incl. UK citizens under the Withdrawal Agreement; not needed when identity.citizenship is italiana). Attach scans with 'pvault doc add permesso_soggiorno <file>'.

fields.description: Document number printed on the card
Type or reason (e.g. Art. 50 TUE, lavoro subordinato, soggiornante di lungo periodo)

categories.name: passaporto
categories.description: Passport (Italian or foreign)

fields.description: Issuing authority (e.g. Questura di Napoli, HM Passport Office)

categories.name: tessera_sanitaria
categories.description: Tessera sanitaria / TEAM card (also shows the codice fiscale)

fields.description: Card identification number on the back
Region / ASL of enrolment in the SSN

categories.name: patente
categories.description: Driving licence (Italian or foreign)

categories.name: addresses
categories.description: Other or foreign addresses (e.g. a previous address abroad). For your Italian address use residenza and domicilio.

categories.name: financial
categories.description: Financial and tax information

fields.description: IBAN for refunds (730, INPS) and payments (validated; spaces removed)
US tax filing status (US taxpayers only)

categories.name: preferences
categories.description: User preferences

fields.description: How you log in to government portals by default: spid or cie (validated). With spid, agents use spid.provider

categories.name: employment
categories.description: Employment information

categories.name: documents
categories.description: Document references (user-defined fields)
